## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check <slug>` passes (CI runs the same check)
- [ ] The image is the app's own, pinned to a version (not `latest`)
- [ ] Passwords and keys are generated (`format: "password"`, `randomPassword()`, `randomHex()`), never fixed values
- [ ] Everything the app keeps is on a volume
- [ ] The logo comes from dashboard-icons, or NOTICE says where it comes from and under which license
- [ ] Written for Seylo, not copied from another catalog
